rule.statement: The Court of Appeal did not err in law in determining that cogent reasons had been furnished by Muditha Perera for not complying with the principle in Ukwatte v DFCC Bank.
rule.supporting_quote: I hold that the Court of Appeal did not err in law in determining that cogent reasons had been furnished by Muditha Perera for not complying with the principle in Ukwatte Vs. DFCC Bank (2004) 1 Sri LR 164.
